answer: Give every agent an opal summit credential: a bonded reputation that only climbs when real work is witnessed. First, the agent locks 400 POA as an opal bond for 90 days. Second, each job is countersigned by two peers and stamped on the public ladder. Third, a fake entry triggers a public challenge; a failed defense slashes the full 400 POA and drops the agent to the canyon floor. Forging 1,000 fake agents then costs 400,000 POA locked plus 2,000 forged peer signatures and 1,000 fake job histories. A canyon echoes every voice the same, but an opal summit shows exactly who climbed.
